name: WF03 — Exact Voice + Script Fit Loop

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id)
SELECT i.job_id AS requested_job_id,j.id AS job_id,j.language_code,j.target_duration_seconds,j.content_model_version,j.script_text,j.script_support,j.duration_preflight,
       j.status,j.current_stage,j.voiceover_path,j.voiceover_duration_seconds,j.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
       COUNT(s.id)::int AS scene_count
FROM input i LEFT JOIN public.jobs j ON j.id=i.job_id LEFT JOIN public.scenes s ON s.job_id=j.id
GROUP BY i.job_id,j.id,j.language_code,j.target_duration_seconds,j.content_model_version,j.script_text,j.script_support,j.duration_preflight,j.status,j.current_stage,j.voiceover_path,j.voiceover_duration_seconds;

WITH u AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs j SET status='processing',current_stage='voiceover',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE j.id=$1::uuid AND j.content_model_version='staged_v1' AND j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='script'
   AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(j.voiceover_path,'')),'') IS NULL AND j.voiceover_duration_seconds IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=j.id)
 RETURNING j.id
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) AS ready_to_run;

parameters.jsCode: const t=$input.first().json;const j=$('Require Eligible Voiceover Job').first().json;if(t.ready_to_run!==true)throw new Error(`Job ${j.job_id} could not enter voiceover stage`);const voices={en:'en-US-AndrewNeural',pl:'pl-PL-MarekNeural',ru:'ru-RU-DmitryNeural',uk:'uk-UA-OstapNeural'};const voice=voices[j.language_code];if(!voice)throw new Error('Unsupported language');if(j.duration_preflight?.exact_tts_required!==true)throw new Error('Exact TTS contract is missing');return [{json:{job_id:j.job_id,language_code:j.language_code,target_duration_seconds:Number(j.target_duration_seconds),provider:'google_gemini',model:'gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts',voice:'Kore',edge_fallback_voice:voice,script_text:j.script_text,script_support:j.script_support,fit_pass:Number(j.script_fit_passes??0),max_fit_passes:2}}];

const stored=$input.first().json;let ctx;try{ctx=$('Resume Rewritten Voiceover').all().at(-1)?.json}catch{}if(!ctx)ctx=$('Prepare Continuous Voiceover').first().json;const path=String(stored.voiceover_path??'').trim(),duration=Number(stored.duration_seconds),bytes=Number(stored.bytes);if(!path||!Number.isFinite(duration)||duration<=0||!Number.isFinite(bytes)||bytes<=0)throw new Error('Edge TTS returned invalid voiceover metadata');const provider=String(stored.provider??''),model=String(stored.model??''),voice=String(stored.voice??'');const gemini=provider==='google_gemini'&&model==='gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts'&&voice==='Kore';const edge=provider==='microsoft_edge_readaloud'&&model==='edge_neural'&&voice===ctx.edge_fallback_voice;if(!gemini&&!edge)throw new Error('Natural TTS provider/voice contract changed');if(edge&&(Number(stored.rate_percent)!==0||Number(stored.post_tempo_factor)!==1))throw new Error('Speech-speed manipulation is forbidden');const target=Number(ctx.target_duration_seconds),tol=1/30,min=(target*0.90)-tol,max=(target*1.10)+tol;const duration_fit=duration>=min-1e-9&&duration<=max+1e-9;return [{json:{...ctx,voiceover_path:path,duration_seconds:duration,bytes,provider,model,voice,duration_fit,target_min_seconds:Number(min.toFixed(3)),target_max_seconds:Number(max.toFixed(3))}}];

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
 SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,$2::text AS voiceover_path,$3::numeric AS voiceover_duration,$4::text AS provider,$5::text AS model,$6::text AS voice,$7::jsonb AS timings,$8::text AS final_script,$9::jsonb AS final_support,$10::smallint AS fit_passes
), locked AS (
 SELECT j.id,j.target_duration_seconds FROM public.jobs j,input i
 WHERE j.id=i.job_id AND j.content_model_version='staged_v1' AND j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='voiceover'
   AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(j.voiceover_path,'')),'') IS NULL AND j.voiceover_duration_seconds IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=j.id)
 FOR UPDATE
), parsed AS (
 SELECT x.* FROM input i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(i.timings) AS x(
   scene_number integer,narration text,narration_support_evidence_ids jsonb,beat_start_seconds numeric,beat_end_seconds numeric,duration_seconds numeric,status text
 )
), expected AS (
 SELECT id,CASE target_duration_seconds WHEN 15 THEN 6 WHEN 30 THEN 10 WHEN 45 THEN 14 WHEN 60 THEN 18 END AS beat_count FROM locked
), valid AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM parsed p,expected e
 WHERE p.scene_number BETWEEN 1 AND e.beat_count AND NULLIF(BTRIM(p.narration),'') IS NOT NULL AND p.status='timed'
   AND jsonb_typeof(p.narration_support_evidence_ids)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.narration_support_evidence_ids)>0
   AND p.beat_start_seconds>=0 AND p.beat_end_seconds>p.beat_start_seconds AND p.duration_seconds>0
   AND ABS((p.beat_end_seconds-p.beat_start_seconds)-p.duration_seconds)<=0.01
   AND NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p.narration_support_evidence_ids) q(evidence_id)
     WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.job_evidence je WHERE je.job_id=e.id AND je.evidence_id=q.evidence_id)
   )
), ok AS (
 SELECT e.id,e.beat_count FROM expected e,input i
 WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(i.voiceover_path),'') IS NOT NULL AND i.voiceover_duration>0
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM valid)=e.beat_count AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT scene_number) FROM valid)=e.beat_count
), ins AS (
 INSERT INTO public.scenes(job_id,scene_number,narration,narration_support_evidence_ids,beat_start_seconds,beat_end_seconds,duration_seconds,status)
 SELECT o.id,v.scene_number,v.narration,v.narration_support_evidence_ids,v.beat_start_seconds,v.beat_end_seconds,v.duration_seconds,'timed'
 FROM ok o CROSS JOIN valid v ORDER BY v.scene_number RETURNING job_id
), upd AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs j SET voiceover_path=i.voiceover_path,voiceover_duration_seconds=i.voiceover_duration,voiceover_provider=i.provider,voiceover_model=i.model,voiceover_voice=i.voice,script_text=i.final_script,script_support=i.final_support,script_fit_passes=i.fit_passes,last_error=NULL,updated_at=now()
 FROM input i,ok o WHERE j.id=o.id AND j.id=i.job_id RETURNING j.id,j.status,j.current_stage
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM ins) AS beats_inserted,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) AS job_updated,
       (SELECT status FROM upd LIMIT 1) AS status,(SELECT current_stage FROM upd LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,$2::text AS voiceover_path,$3::numeric AS voiceover_duration_seconds;
UPDATE public.jobs SET status='failed',current_stage='voiceover',last_error=$2::text,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING id AS job_id,status,current_stage,last_error;

parameters.jsCode: const base=$('Prepare Duration Rewrite').first().json;const r=$input.first().json;let t=String(r.text??'').trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,'').trim();let o;try{o=JSON.parse(t)}catch{throw new Error('duration rewrite model returned invalid JSON')};const script=String(o.script??'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim();if(!script)throw new Error('duration rewrite returned empty script');const wc=script.match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]+(?:[’'\-][\p{L}\p{N}]+)*/gu)?.length??0;if(wc<base.desired_word_min-8||wc>base.desired_word_max+8)throw new Error(`duration rewrite word count ${wc} missed broad target ${base.desired_word_min}-${base.desired_word_max}`);const old=Array.isArray(base.script_support)?base.script_support:[];const evidence=[...new Set(old.map(s=>String(s.evidence_id??'')).filter(Boolean))];if(!evidence.length)throw new Error('duration rewrite lost evidence provenance');const sentences=script.match(/[^.!?…]+[.!?…]+|[^.!?…]+$/gu)?.map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)??[script];const support=sentences.map((text,i)=>({segment_number:i+1,evidence_id:evidence[i%evidence.length],source_id:evidence[i%evidence.length],source_text:'supported by preserved job evidence',text,transform:'duration_rewrite_same_facts'}));return [{json:{job_id:base.job_id,language_code:base.language_code,target_duration_seconds:Number(base.target_duration_seconds),provider:base.provider,model:base.model,voice:base.voice,edge_fallback_voice:base.edge_fallback_voice,script_text:script,script_support:support,fit_pass:Number(base.next_fit_pass),max_fit_passes:Number(base.max_fit_passes??2)}}];

parameters.query: UPDATE public.jobs SET script_text=$2,script_support=$3::jsonb,script_fit_passes=$4,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='processing' AND current_stage='voiceover' RETURNING id::text AS job_id,script_fit_passes;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;const x=$('Apply Duration Rewrite').first().json;if(!r.job_id)throw new Error('duration rewrite did not persist');return [{json:x}];

let ctx;try{ctx=$('Resume Rewritten Voiceover').all().at(-1)?.json}catch{}if(!ctx)ctx=$('Prepare Continuous Voiceover').first().json;if(!ctx?.job_id||!ctx?.script_text)throw new Error('Edge fallback context is missing');return [{json:ctx}];
